name: Despair Shaman Spirit
body:
A shaman who selects the despair spirit is imposing and exudes a palpable feeling that nothing matters.

Spirit Magic Spells: lesser crushing despair (1st), lesser symbol of despair (2nd), crushing despair (modified) (3rd), symbol of despair (4th), hopeless shadow (5th), greater crushing despair (6th), greater symbol of despair (7th), unholy aura (8th), aspect of the hope devourer (9th)

Hexes: A shaman who chooses the despair spirit can select from the following hexes.

Feed upon Doubts (Su)

As a standard action, you may touch one creature affected by a despair effect. If the touch attack succeeds, the creature is dealt 1d8 plus your shaman level negative energy damage and the despair effect is dispelled. Additionally, you gain the benefits of the death knell spell for 10 minutes per shaman level. Once affected by this hex, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Forceful Doubt (Su)

Your spells gain a +4 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome the spell resistance against those to resist your despair spells. At 12th level, you may ignore the immunity of any creature against despair effects. In such cases the formerly-immune creature gains a +5 bonus on their SR.

Pitiful Foe (Su)

You can temporarily curse one target within 30 feet as a standard action, making it pitiful and ineffective in battle. While this ability is in effect, the target is never considered to be threatening you or your allies, even if it is armed and you or your allies are standing in a square into which it can make a melee attack. If the target rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll or saving throw, the attack or saving throw is not an automatic success (as would be normal) and whether it is successful is instead determined normally.

Additionally, the target automatically fails all rolls to confirm critical hits. This curse lasts for 1 round per 2 shaman levels you have (minimum 1). A successful Will saving throw negates this effect. This is a mind-affecting curse effect. Once affected by this hex, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Revel in Despair (Ex)

Anytime you are subject to a despair effect, you do not suffer the penalties of the effect, instead you gain a morale bonus equal to the former penalty. Additionally anytime you are in the area of a despair effect cast by yourself or your allies that affects enemies, you may choose to be affected by that effect.

Touch of Despair (Su)

As a standard action, you can perform a melee touch attack that causes a living creature to become doubting. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your shaman level (minimum 1 round). Once affected by this hex, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Spirit Animal: The shaman’s spirit animal seems to be drained of color and moves with a slinking gait. It gains a +2 Initiative bonus and a +4 bonus on Stealth checks.

Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the despair spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability.

Channel (Su)

You can channel negative energy like a cleric, using your shaman level as your effective cleric level when determining the amount of damage dealt.

This channeling cannot be used to heal undead. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier.

Greater Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the despair spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the greater version of that spirit.

Boon of Despair (Sp)

Whenever a creature fails a saving throw and takes damage from one of your spells, it is doubting for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s level. Spells that do not allow saves do not cause creatures to become doubting. This does not stack with other despair effects.

True Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the despair spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the true version of that spirit.

Dashed Hopes (Su)

When you cast a spell with the despair descriptor you may harm one of the affected spell targets per 5 levels (minimum 1). The damage dealt is equal to 1d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells up to 3rd level, 2d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells from 4th to 6th level, and 3d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells from 7th to 9th levels. The damage dealt is negative energy damage but may not be used to heal undead. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level, and every five levels thereafter.

Manifestation: At 20th level, you become a force of hopelessness exuding an aura of despair out to 30 feet.

Any spell with the despair descriptor cast within the aura is automatically extended per the metamagic feat without increasing the spell level. This extension does not stack with an application of the metamagic feat.

Additionally, you may suppress any morale bonus within the aura. Each morale bonus may be selectively suppressed but a change in what is suppressed is an immediate action.
